description.value: Founded in 1995 by Belgian-trained pastry chef Olivier Lebeau, this patisserie specializes in authentic Liège and Bruxelles waffles, rice pies, craquelins, and speculoos made fresh daily from natural ingredients. Located on West 2nd Avenue near the Arbutus Greenway, it sits along a popular Vancouver cycling corridor. The shop has been a proud multi-year waffle sponsor of Ride to Conquer Cancer and a supplier for Tour de Cure, giving it a genuine footprint in the local cycling community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at grababetterwaffle.com is fully accessible and richly detailed, confirming address, phone, and business identity. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; only takeout/delivery is confirmed via OSM takeaway=yes and website Pick-Up/Delivery section. Notably, the wholesale page documents a 10+ year sponsorship of Ride to Conquer Cancer and supply of the Tour de Cure, establishing a meaningful cycling community connection.
concerns: OSM had no phone number; phone 604-731-3528 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
OSM opening_hours lists 07:30 start but website consistently states 8am open; minor discrepancy (hours not stored per rules, but flagged for OSM data quality).
Website domain grababetterwaffle.com does not reflect the business name, though all content clearly identifies the business as Pâtisserie Lebeau.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established, active patisserie on the Arbutus Greenway cycling corridor with confirmed takeout and a documented multi-year sponsorship of major BC cycling charity events; well-suited as a food stop in the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Wholesale page notes 10+ years as Ride to Conquer Cancer waffle sponsor and 2024 Tour de Cure supplier — worth highlighting in any editorial copy about cycling-community ties.
